en.html:
Hachimangu is the centre of Kamakura. Geography, history, politics: whichever department one asks, same answer.

In Imperial Year 1723—1063 by the foreign calendar—Yoriyoshi Minamoto, second head of the Seiwa-line Kawachi Genji, enshrined the clan god Hachiman in his territory of Tsurugaoka. About a hundred years later, his descendant Yoritomo established Kamakura as the warriors' capital, with Hachimangu at its centre.

For eight hundred years since, Kamakura's Hachimangu has been guardian of the Genji. No, of warriors altogether. Rokuhara, which now claims leadership of the Genji, displays extraordinary devotion.

A few scheduled visits each year will not satisfy this devotion. Auspicious occasion, inauspicious occasion, ceremony must happen. And once political publicity enters the ceremony, naturally it requires a very large seat. Everything becomes grand.

The frequent rebuilding and expensive ornament are probably for the same reason. Decoration of the building, decoration of authority. Two jobs, same expense.

The person invited all the way from Kyoto and installed in the inner hall is, one could say, another such ornament.

Deep within the grounds stands a small, quiet hall. Tradition says the dance pavilion, now near the centre, once occupied this spot. Hence its other name: the Inner Dance Pavilion, or Inner Maidono.

The resident takes his title from that tradition.

八幡宮は鎌倉の中心にあるといえる。
　地理的にも、歴史的にも、政治的にも。

　国紀一七二三（外暦一〇六三）年、清和系河内源氏
二代目棟梁にあたる源頼義が氏神たる八幡神を所領で
あった鶴岡に祀り――およそ百年後、彼の後裔頼朝は
八幡宮を中心に武家の都・鎌倉を開く。

　爾来八百年、鎌倉の八幡宮は源氏の守護神……否、
武士の守護神として在った。
　現代において源氏棟梁を称する六波羅一門も、並々
ならぬ崇敬を寄せている。

　年数回の定例参拝を行うのみならず、慶事凶事の折
につけ祭儀を催した。
　その種の事業は政治宣伝の色合いを帯びずにはいら
れない。勢い盛大なものになる。

　頻繁に改築を行い、豪奢な装いを調えることも理由
は同じだろう。美観上の装飾はつまり政治上の装飾。
　――言うなれば、その一つなのだ。はるばる京の都
から招かれ、奥殿へ迎えられたかの人物も。

　八幡宮境内の深部にひっそりと建つ小殿……
　現在は中央付近にある<ruby>舞殿<rt>まいどの</rt></ruby>が、かつてはその場所に
あったと伝えられる。故に一名、奥舞殿。

　小殿の主が称する名はその伝承に由来した。

en.html:
Prince Haruhiro of Maidono.

Youngest son of the late emperor, and second in the succession after Crown Prince Motohiro.

His installation as Hachimangu's chief of rites demonstrates the depth of Rokuhara's faith and devotion to the throne. That is the explanation, officially. Kindly admire the devotion and ask nothing further.

In reality, it demonstrates that Rokuhara can move even the imperial family to suit itself. And he is a hostage, bas. A human sacrifice supplied by Kyoto.

That is the position of the shadow wavering behind the bamboo blind.

　先帝の末子にあたり、皇位継承順位では基煕皇太子
に次ぐ第二位に位置する。

　彼が八幡宮の祭祀長職たる別当として奉じられた事
は、まさしく六波羅の信仰心と勤皇精神の厚かりしを
顕すものに他ならない。
　……ということに、されていた。表向きは。

　実際のところ。
　皇室をも自在に動かし得るという六波羅の権威表明
であり、そして――人質に過ぎない。
　京都が六波羅に差し出した人身御供。

　御簾の向こうにゆらめく影は、そうした存在だった。

Kageaki"I beg forgiveness. Forgetting Your Highness's many kindnesses, I allowed my tongue its own authority. With my forehead to the floor, I apologise."
Prince Maidono"Arre, don't say that. Always you are doing things for me..."

Prince Maidono"Haan, that. This Silver Star business. Always the difficult part is put on you alone. I'm truly sorry about that."

Kageaki"Ji."
Prince Maidono"...Why you, I wonder? So many people, and it has to be you. God also can be very cruel..."
Kageaki"..."
Kageaki"Those words, Your Highness. Give them instead to the innocent people who died by my hand."
Kageaki"Not me. Them."
Prince Maidono"...Haan. Perhaps so. Perhaps..."
Prince Maidono"Listen, Kageaki."
Kageaki"Yes."

Prince Maidono"Unpleasant thing to ask. I know. Samajhta hoon, I understand, but..."
Prince Maidono"My responsibility I want to fulfil. Not only about Silver Star, this..."
Kageaki"..."

Honestly, I would prefer to be excused. Refuse, and he would probably not force me.

Silver Star is my private matter. Other people's opinions do not change that. The distance he calls 'far away' is rather welcome to me. I have no business shortening it.

But just now, with my own mouth, I declared the situation. Only His Highness's decree, outside ordinary law, lets me leave prison to pursue Silver Star.

An Armour Racer who can run only because a sponsor pays. That is my position also. The sponsor makes one earnest request; what room is there for my yes-no deliberations?

I begin in order. As little feeling as possible in the words. That much I can try.

When I finish, Prince Maidono calls for tea. We take it with the bamboo blind between us. As tea ceremony goes, this seems far outside proper procedure. Neither prince nor chief is troubled; perhaps improper procedure is the usual procedure here.

Achha. Two men behaving naturally, one man worrying whether nature is permitted. That would be me. The tea itself has arrived without difficulty. Only I am trying to carry it through eight hundred years of correct behaviour before allowing it near my mouth.

At their urging I relax my posture a little and take a bowl. Sweets have also been placed within reach.

舞殿宮「やっぱ知り合いかい。 　さっきの景明くんの話に出てきたＧＨＱの 大鳥巡察官って、この人なんやろ？」
景明「はい。まさしく。 　しかし何故、この方々がここに」
舞殿宮「いやあ、ほんのついさっき、今日の昼前の ことなんやけどね……。 　あぁ、香奈枝さんにおさよさん。そのへん 好きに座って下さい。いま茶ぁ運ばせるから」
香奈枝「どうかお構いなく。 　……ふふっ。本当に、あっという間に再会 が叶いましたね。景明さま」
景明「は……」
さよ「赤い糸の導きというものでございましょう」
香奈枝「きゃっ。もうばあやったら、いやなひと」
景明「……」
舞殿宮「なんや、随分仲良しさんやないか。 　隅に置けんな、景明くん」
署長「宮殿下？」
舞殿宮「ああ、うん。 　昼前にこの二人がわしんとこ来てな。何の 御用か聞いてみたら、八幡宮付の将校として 着任しはったっていう話でねえ」
署長「……は。 　なるほど」
舞殿宮「ＧＨＱがそういうのを寄越してくれるって 話は前からあったやろう？ 　その人選がやっと決まって、このお二人が 来たってことみたいやわ」
舞殿宮「わし、すっかり忘れてたよ」
香奈枝「当方の不手際で宮殿下には不自由をお掛け してしまいました。 　申し訳ございません」
舞殿宮「いやいや、気にせんといて。 　わしが進駐軍の元帥さまでもわしのことは ほっとくと思うえ。何の役にも立たんアホの お守りなんて誰もやりたがらんやろしなぁ」
舞殿宮「香奈枝さんも御苦労なこっちゃ。 　貧乏籤引かせてしもうたなぁ」
香奈枝「……そのようなこと。 　進駐軍司令部はこの国の政局で重責を担わ れている舞殿宮殿下のことを常に気に掛けて おります」
香奈枝「わたくしの職務は司令部を代表して宮殿下 のお側に仕え、諸事に便宜を図ること。 　きっとお役に立ちましょう。殿下におかれ ては心置きなく、何なりとお命じ下さいまし」
舞殿宮「……そうですか。 　それは有り難いお話や。なぁ、署長？」
署長「は。 　まったく、良い人が来てくれたものです」

The chief falls silent, expression undecided. The wrinkles by his mouth say: now it has become difficult.

I can follow his thinking. Define her powers clearly—even very harsh powers—and one can use the definition against her. Authority means permission to do those things, and not other things. The cage has bars on both sides.

But no powers, merely 'assist in all matters'? That phrase can swallow any interpretation, crooked ones included, and still ask for more.

Possibly worse. No compulsion, certainly. But look at our respective positions. Every dealing must show the appropriate consideration. Her lack of authority does not make GHQ smaller.

...Depending, also, on where Captain Ootori herself stands. Absolute loyalty to the League Army? There are signs that the answer is not so simple...

But no powers, merely 'assist in all matters'? That phrase can swallow any interpretation, crooked ones included, and still ask for more.

Possibly worse. No compulsion, certainly. But look at our respective positions. Every dealing must show the appropriate consideration. Her lack of authority does not make GHQ smaller.

...Depending, also, on where Captain Ootori herself stands. Absolute loyalty to the League Army? There are signs that the answer is not so simple...
